schema_string: string tokenId,string zoraContract,string metadataURI,string continuityCommit,string receiptHash,string replayHash,string laneRoot,string zoraRef,bool isSoulbound,uint256 mintTimestamp

fields.name: tokenId
fields.description: Zora 1155 token id as a string to preserve cross-tool compatibility.

fields.name: zoraContract
fields.description: Zora 1155 contract address or contract pointer.

fields.name: metadataURI
fields.description: IPFS, Arweave, HTTPS, or ENS-linked metadata URI.

fields.name: continuityCommit
fields.description: Git commit SHA anchoring the continuity entry.

fields.name: receiptHash
fields.description: sha256 receipt hash for the continuity artifact.

fields.name: replayHash
fields.description: sha256 hash of deterministic replay output.

fields.name: laneRoot
fields.description: sha256 hash over the relevant ACTIVE_LANES lane object or lane bundle.

fields.name: zoraRef
fields.description: Human-readable Zora reference such as contract:tokenId or URL.

fields.name: isSoulbound
fields.description: Whether the minted proof should be treated as non-transferable by policy.

fields.name: mintTimestamp
fields.description: Unix timestamp for mint or planned mint. Zero is allowed only for dry-run drafts.

promotion_gates.dry_run_pass: JSON and ABI field order validate and hashes are deterministic.
promotion_gates.registered_unverified: SchemaUID and tx hash exist but replay has not validated them.
promotion_gates.validated: SchemaUID, tx hash, schema string, lane root, and replay hash validate with delta_h 0.
